intent_snapshot.goal: Issue #423 (Spec docs/specs/clarify-inventive-catalyst.spec.md). An explicit exhaustive clarify interrogation checks the concept against seven lenses: the six existing ones plus inventive catalyst, which asks which trade-off the design accepts as inevitable, inlines the ten EGM agents/inventive_catalyst.md@6a8001e pattern names, requires each proposed pattern to state its secondary cost, treats theoretical bounds and Immune-Brain authority invariants as bounds rather than contradictions, and records 'No false compromise detected' instead of inventing a transform. docs/reference/planning-quality-gate.md gains an advisory false-compromise check for Medium/High risk Specs before finalization, presented under the design-option presentation rule and never a Planner decision, and the draw-up Planning Quality Gate bullet points at it. Mirrors regenerated via scripts/sync-dist-docs.ts and scripts/build-antigravity-plugin.ts; patch changeset. Out: Review prompts, imm-plan validator, Default/roundtable/adversarial clarify modes, IFR and severity tiers, subagent dispatch. Instruction text and contract tests only; no runtime, Kernel, Port, schema or state change.

acceptance.assertion: Spec AC1 (BR-REQ-1..5, BR-DEC-1; D1-D5). Existing cases in the file still pass.

Spec AC3 (BR-REQ-8). Done looks like: existing clarify, draw-up and planning-quality-gate contracts still hold.
